title: Providers
emptyDescription: Add your first LLM provider to get started.

form.name: Name *
form.apiKeyEditPlaceholder: Leave as-is or enter new key
form.apiKeySetHint: API key is set. Clear and type a new value to change it.
form.configureOauth: Connect one named ChatGPT OAuth account. Each alias represents a separate ChatGPT account.
form.oauthAliasHint: Use a unique lowercase alias for this ChatGPT account. Add more aliases later for extra accounts or round robin.
form.oauthDisplayNameHint: Optional friendly label shown in the UI. Helpful when you have multiple ChatGPT OAuth accounts.

delete.title: Delete Provider
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

acp.description: Orchestrate ACP-compatible coding agents as subprocesses. No API key needed.
acp.binaryHint: Path or name of the ACP agent binary (e.g. claude, codex, gemini)
acp.argsHint: Space-separated arguments passed to the binary
acp.idleTTLHint: Kill idle processes after this duration (e.g. 5m, 1h)

oauth.authSuccessfulDesc: This named ChatGPT account is ready to use.
oauth.modelPrefixExample: in agent config (e.g. chatgpt-main/gpt-5.4). Token refreshes automatically.
oauth.multiAccountHint: Add more named ChatGPT OAuth accounts to unlock preferred plus extra accounts or round robin routing on an agent.
oauth.aliasRequired: Enter a valid lowercase account alias before starting ChatGPT OAuth.
oauth.signInDesc: Each ChatGPT OAuth provider is one named account. Sign in to use your ChatGPT subscription without a separate API key.
oauth.waiting: Waiting for authentication... Complete sign-in in the opened window.
oauth.remoteVpsHint: After signing in, your browser will try to open
oauth.remoteVpsError: and show a "Can't reach this page" error. That's normal — copy the full URL from the browser address bar and paste it below.

detail.title: Provider Details
detail.oauthConfigDesc: Manage sign-in for this named ChatGPT account
detail.oauthAliasReadonly: OAuth account alias, cannot be changed
detail.enabledDesc: Provider is active and available for agents
detail.oauthAccountUsageDesc: How this alias works as a preferred account and as an extra routed account.
detail.oauthPreferredHint: Set an agent's Provider field to this alias to make it the preferred ChatGPT account.
detail.oauthRoutingHint: Add other authenticated ChatGPT OAuth aliases in Agent Advanced > ChatGPT OAuth Routing for extra accounts or round robin.
detail.oauthDisplayNameRecommendation: Add a display name if you want clearer labels when multiple ChatGPT OAuth accounts appear in routing.

embedding.enableDesc: Allow this provider to generate text embeddings for memory, skills, and knowledge graph
embedding.apiBaseHint: Override if embedding endpoint differs from the provider's main API base

pageHint.title: Multiple ChatGPT OAuth accounts are supported
pageHint.description: Each ChatGPT OAuth provider is one named account. Create aliases like chatgpt-main or chatgpt-work, then add extra accounts from Agent Advanced > ChatGPT OAuth Routing.
